q3.per_holding_ui_exists_note: For the ANALYSIS filing form: no per-holding row list. The only editable per-security rows in the Ticket Center are the TRADE request form (TradeRequestParts.tsx, securitiesFromRows), which is not the analysis filing and carries no upload.
q3.override_member_scope: On the submit (AnalysisSubmissionRequest) there is no per-holding member: additionalProperties is false and the members are request_id, client_id, account_ids, snapshot_id, variant, comparison_keys, report_title, input_id, prepared_for, ticket_id, commentary_requested. The only per-ticker override channel is the UPLOAD request's corrections[] (from_value, to_value, finding_code), template lane only (AnalysisUploadRequest.schema.json:65-96), which is not on the submit.
q3.how_acceptance_reaches_backend: Not through the submit body and not by rewriting the file in the page. An accepted suggestion re-posts the SAME upload (same upload_token and file_base64) to POST /analysis/inputs with corrections:[{finding_code:'TICKER_NOT_FOUND', from_value:<file symbol>, to_value:<suggested symbol>}] (withCorrections in tabs/analysis/prospect.ts; the door replaces the symbol before the provider check, uploads.py:597-600). The next revision returns the new input_id, which the existing submit already carries (analysisBody, analysisRequest.ts:382). No new wire member is needed for the accept path.

points_not_met.point: 1: closest entry by exact CUSIP or ISIN match first
points_not_met.why: Not possible: the uploaded file carries only a ticker in A and an amount in B (template_reader.py:420, 451-452), and the served catalogue carries no identifier (comparison_catalogue.py:116, 147-159; ComparisonCatalogue.schema.json:29).

points_not_met.point: 1: 'a holding whose symbol is not in the served catalogue'
points_not_met.why: Ill-defined as a trigger: the catalogue is 5 model entries plus named etf-classifications tickers (comparison_catalogue.py:184-200), not the holdings universe, so membership would flag nearly every stock holding. The trigger must be the server's TICKER_NOT_FOUND finding instead.

points_not_met.point: 2: a kept unknown symbol files as typed and goes to the backend
points_not_met.why: Not met from what exists: TICKER_NOT_FOUND is severity ERROR (portfolio.py:440, 501) and any ERROR keeps the upload at NEEDS_CORRECTION with nothing filed (portfolio.py:578; uploads.py:569-584). The only accepted resolution today is a correction re-post. This needs a BACKEND change.

points_not_met.point: 4: suggestion reads only the served catalogue, no vendor call at filing
points_not_met.why: Conflicts with the existing mechanism: the Y-4 suggestion calls the provider during the upload (upload_suggestions.py:19, 26; uploads.py:578-580). The catalogue has no ticker-to-typo signal beyond names. The form itself makes no new call (TicketCenter.tsx:329 reads the catalogue already loaded).

points_not_met.point: 2 and 1: the form must hold per-holding rows to show a suggestion per row
points_not_met.why: Not held today: the page holds the file bytes and the findings words only (TicketCenter.tsx:228; analysisRequest.ts:253-261). The suggestion can be attached to the finding, which carries row and value, not to a row list.

q4.deciding_fact: The upload door refuses an unknown ticker: TICKER_NOT_FOUND is severity ERROR (portfolio.py:440, 501) and any ERROR keeps the upload at NEEDS_CORRECTION with nothing filed (portfolio.py:578). So 'keep as typed files' cannot be met portal-only; the accept path (Did you mean, then a corrections re-post on the same token) needs no backend or wire change and is portal-only.
